outcome.technical: plugins/audit/tests/_harness.py: added GIT (the fixture prefix: fixture identity, gpgsign off, init.defaultBranch=main), GIT_TIMEOUT=60, git(cwd, *argv, prefix=GIT, timeout=GIT_TIMEOUT) which raises RuntimeError 'git <argv> failed: <git stderr decoded utf-8/replace> (exit N)' on non-zero exit and 'git <argv> did not finish within <timeout>s; stderr so far: ...' on timeout, and returns decoded stdout; added tail_bytes(text, limit) (moved from test_drive_phase._tail_bytes); worktree_pair and the selftest's rev-parse probe use git(). Migrated every checked fixture git call: test_drive_phase (_repo init/add/commit, _drive_follower_map and every other fixture's add/commit loops, tdd fixtures, _commit_plan, worktree add, CRLF commit, _head, the dd4 status read), test_integrate_task (_run now delegates to _harness.git with its own t@t.t prefix and timeout=30; message format kept so _TAIL_NEEDLE still matches), test_hooks (_git with its corpus prefix), test_run_test_gate (every init/-C add/commit/checkout/rev-parse/status fixture call and _sm_git, all with prefix=_PLAIN_GIT=('git',) or ['git']+_SM_GIT so the environment is byte-identical: these fixtures name identity per commit and leave the branch name to git). Locale-pinned reporters: fm-block re-run case now reports _harness.tail_bytes(res['err'], 600) (was the head clip), _integrate_ascii_verdict uses _harness.tail_bytes. Kept their own shape on purpose: test_drive_phase _git_out (reads output of calls that legitimately exit non-zero, e.g. config --get of a missing key), the to_signed add -A/commit pair (unchecked: the signoff verb may already have committed), the wq2m RED TWIN's checkout inside a product override (deliberately unchecked), and the shell recipe 'git show HEAD:map.fresh > ...' (a recipe string, not a fixture argv). Two run_test_gate commits that previously had NO check (tmp 'base' commit before the retry-head comparison, sigroot 'base' commit before is6) are now checked through the helper, as are the is6 head/porcelain reads that were unchecked; on success behaviour and assertions are unchanged, on failure they now raise with git's message instead of comparing two empty heads. New cases in test_drive_phase al-block (_fixture_git_case, called from _ascii_locale_cases): the titled case asserts a failing call's message carries git's own line and '(exit ', a hung prefix names 'did not finish within 1s', a child under ASCII_ENV failing in _harness.git after 200 noise lines is reported with the RuntimeError line within 600 bytes, no suite in (_harness, test_drive_phase, test_integrate_task, test_run_test_gate, test_hooks) has a subprocess.run naming git with check=True (AST scan bare_git_calls), and the pinned-child block has no head clip and both tail reporters; fg1m RED TWIN pins the scanner both ways ([1, 2] on a five-line twin). Runs: al-block stage 5/5 pass exit 0; ruff 0; vermin 0; python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py exit 0 (335/335 files ok, 16433 cases); --encoding cp1252 exit 0 (335/335 files ok, both halves ran).
